name: Madagascar Centella Ampoule Foam 4.22 fl.oz, 125ml, Low pH Foam Cleanser, Natural Soda Powder Coconut Surfactant and EWG Green Grade
description:
Centella Ampoule Foam

- A rich, foaming cleanser with an ideal pH of 5 that removes makeup and impurities without stripping the skin

- Provides advanced cleansing performance, removing up to 92.69% of fine dust

- Ultra-fine baking soda powder helps lift away excess sebum and buildup for a refreshed feel

- Coconut-derived surfactants gently cleanse while helping maintain the skin’s moisture balance

- Formulated with Centella extract to leave the skin feeling soothed and balanced
